DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお席のご注文は、まだ途中でしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We had not finished taking this table's order, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。別の席へ呼ばれる前にお肉だけ伝えました。ご飯の数をまだ言っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中断前は肉だけ伝えご飯数は未伝達と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Before you were called to another table, I had only mentioned the meat. I have not said how many rice servings yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that before the interruption you had ordered only meat, not the rice quantity. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お肉は二皿と伺っています。ご飯は、おいくつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have two plates of meat. How many rice servings?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ご飯は三つです。肉が二皿だから二人分というわけではなく、三人で分けて食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉二皿を三人で分けるためご飯三つを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three rice servings. Two meat plates does not mean two people; three of us will share them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order three rice servings for three people sharing two meat plates. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご飯を三つ追加します。お飲み物は、決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will add three rice servings. Have you decided on drinks?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人がまだ席へ戻っていないので、飲み物はその人が戻ってから三人で決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人未帰席のため飲物は後で三人で決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: One person has not returned to the table yet, so we would like to decide on drinks together when they return.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say one person is still away and all three will decide drinks later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お肉とご飯を先に通し、飲み物は後で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will put through the meat and rice first and ask about drinks later.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうしてください。先ほど言いかけた「あと」は、ご飯を追加したいという意味でした。肉の追加ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 言いかけた追加は肉でなくご飯だったと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. When I started saying “also” earlier, I meant adding rice, not more meat.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clarify that the addition you started mentioning meant rice, not meat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お肉二皿、ご飯三つで承りました。お飲み物は未注文です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Two plates of meat and three rice servings confirmed. No drinks ordered yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その内容で合っています。戻ってきた友人にも、飲み物はまだ頼んでいないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定注文を確認し友人へ飲物未注文を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: That is correct. I will also tell my friend when they return that we have not ordered drinks yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the order and say you will tell your friend drinks are not ordered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お肉とご飯をご用意します。またお声がけください。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare the meat and rice. Call us again when ready. Enjoy your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の課題について、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about today's assignment you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の声を二回録音しました。二回目の方が上手なので、一回目を消してから送ろうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自声二回録音で一回目を削除してよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I recorded my voice twice. The second is better, so I was thinking of deleting the first before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether you may delete the first of two recordings of your own voice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の課題では、一回目と練習後の二回目を比べます。両方残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this assignment, we compare the first recording and the second after practice. Keep both.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 消す前に聞けてよかったです。一回目は文の途中で止まりましたが、その部分も残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 途中停止した一回目も保存対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am glad I asked before deleting it. I stopped in the middle of a sentence in the first; should that part remain too?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether to keep even the first recording with its mid-sentence stop. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 止まった所も含めて残してください。どこが変わったか、一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep it, including where you stopped. We will check together what changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。最初のファイルには「一回目」、後の方には「練習後」と名前を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの録音に一回目と練習後の名前を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will name the first file “First attempt” and the later one “After practice.”
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Name the recordings first attempt and after practice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 録音に、ほかの方の声は入っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does the recording contain anyone else's voice?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で一人で読んだので、入っているのは私の声だけです。授業を録音した物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で本人声のみ録音し授業音声ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I read alone at home, so it contains only my voice. It is not a recording of a lesson.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain you recorded only your own voice at home, not classroom audio. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その二つを送ってください。ご自身で気づいた変化も一つ書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then send both. Also write one change you noticed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文の終わりまで止まらずに読めた、と書きます。一回目を失敗として消さず、二つを送って比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 止まらず読めた変化を書き両方送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write that I could read to the end of the sentence without stopping. Instead of deleting the first as a failure, I want to send both and compare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write that you could read without stopping and say you will send both. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二つの録音をお待ちしています。また次の授業でお会いしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I look forward to receiving both recordings. See you at the next lesson.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お品物のお渡しは済みましたが、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: We have handed over your purchases. Can I help with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲み物で両手がふさがっています。上着のポケットにあるチケットを、自分で出す間だけここへ置いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 両手の飲物を短時間置き自己チケットを取り出したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Both my hands are full of drinks. May I set them here just while I take my ticket out of my jacket pocket myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to set down the drinks briefly to take out your own ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの空いた受渡し台へ、短い間でしたら置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can place them briefly on this empty pickup counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置いてからチケットを出しました。文字が小さいので、座席の段と番号を読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小さい座席の段番号を読み上げてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put them down and took out my ticket. The print is small; could you read the seat row and number?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to read the small seat row and number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 段は十二、番号は十八と書いてあります。入場口ではなく、座席の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It says row twelve, number eighteen. That is the seat field, not the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二段の十八番ですね。先ほど入口の番号だけ覚えていたので、座席の方を確認できて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口番号と違う十二段十八番の座席を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Row twelve, seat eighteen. I had remembered only the entrance number earlier, so checking the seat helps.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm row twelve, seat eighteen, distinct from the entrance number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お席までの通路は、場内の案内係へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask an usher inside about the route to your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。売店の方に席まで案内してもらうのではなく、通路にいる係にこのチケットを見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場内係へチケットを示して通路を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Rather than ask the concession staff to lead me to my seat, I will show this ticket to an usher in the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will show an indoor usher your ticket and ask the route. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: チケットをしまわれましたか。台のお飲み物も、忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you put the ticket away? Remember your drinks on the counter too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: チケットをポケットへ戻し、飲み物も二つ持ちました。友人の分を届けるため、案内係に道を聞いて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: チケット収納と飲物二つを確認し友人席へ戻ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the ticket back in my pocket and took both drinks. I will ask an usher the way and return to deliver my friend's drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your pocketed ticket and two drinks, and say you will return to your friend's seat. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お席へお気をつけてお戻りください。観戦をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care returning to your seat. Enjoy watching the game.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花束ができました。こちらのカードを添えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bouquet is ready. Shall I attach this card?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、私が書いたカードです。送別会には別の人も花を持ってくるので、誰からの花か分かるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別参加者の花と区別するため自己カードを添えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I wrote it. Other people will bring flowers to the farewell party too, so I want it to be clear who these flowers are from.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want your own card attached to distinguish your flowers from other guests' flowers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの最後に、お名前が書かれていますね。こちらを花束へ結びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your name is at the end of the card, I see. I will tie this to the bouquet.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表にお礼の言葉、裏に私の名前を書きました。表だけ見えると名前がないように見えるので、裏も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表のお礼と裏の自己名の両面を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote thanks on the front and my name on the back. Looking only at the front might make it seem unsigned, so please check the back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check both the thanks on the front and your name on the back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 裏のお名前も確認しました。カードに穴を開けて結んでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked your name on the back too. May I punch a hole in the card and tie it on?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前の文字を避けて、上の空いた所なら大丈夫です。真ん中へ穴を開けるのは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字を避け上の空白へ穴を開けることを認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The blank part at the top is fine if you avoid the name's letters. Please avoid making a hole in the middle.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Allow a hole in the top blank area, avoiding the writing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上の角へ穴を開けました。花束のリボンへ結びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I made a hole in the upper corner. I will tie it to the bouquet ribbon.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会場で配る紙ではなく、この花束と一緒に本人へ渡すカードです。外さずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配布紙でなく花束と一緒に渡すカードなので外さないと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. This is a card to give the person with the bouquet, not a sheet to distribute at the venue. Please leave it attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain it is a card accompanying the bouquet, not a handout, and ask them not to remove it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードを付けたまま、運ぶための袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put it in a carrying bag with the card attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これで私の花束とカードを一緒に渡せます。会場でもカードを抜き取らず、このまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会場でもカードを付けたまま本人へ渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Now I can give my bouquet and card together. At the venue too, I will hand it over as it is without pulling the card out.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the recipient the bouquet with the card still attached at the venue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、素敵な送別会になりますように。お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope it is a lovely farewell party. Take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明をお聞きになって、確認したい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: After hearing the explanation, is there anything you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メモに「会社へ確認」と書きました。その下に「今日電話」と書きましたが、今日中にというのは私が考えたことでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社確認の説明と今日電話する自己予定を混ぜたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote “check with the company” in my notes. Under it I wrote “call today,” but doing it today was my own idea.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you mixed the explanation to check with the company with your own plan to call today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 私がお伝えしたのは、勤務先へ内容を確認していただきたいということです。今日中に電話するという指定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: What I said was to check the details with your employer. I did not specify calling today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、「今日電話」は自分の予定の欄へ移します。職員の説明の続きに見える書き方になっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日電話の記述を職員発言から自己予定欄へ移すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will move “call today” to my own plans section. I had written it so it looked like a continuation of the staff's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move “call today” from staff remarks to your own plans. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように分けていただくと、後で読み返しやすいですね。次に確認したいことは何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separating them will make it easier to reread later. What else do you want to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社へ何を聞くかです。この書類の数字について、誰に説明を頼めばよいか、会社の受付へ尋ねるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類の数字を説明できる勤務先担当を尋ねる予定を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: What to ask the company. I plan to ask the company's reception who can explain the numbers on this document.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to ask who at work can explain the document's numbers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先で書類を扱う担当へ、数字の内容を確認してください。不明な点が残れば、その内容をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the numbers' meaning with the person handling the document at your workplace. If questions remain, bring those details.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞いた答えは会社からの説明として書きます。こちらで説明されたことと混ぜずに、別のページへ残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社説明を窓口説明と混ぜず別頁へ記録すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will record the answer as the company's explanation. I will keep it on another page without mixing it with what you explained here.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will record the company's explanation on a separate page from the desk's explanation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の際は、元の書類も一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When asking us for advice, bring the original document too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の書類は取っておきます。今日中という指定はなかったこともメモへ直し、まず会社の担当を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原書類を保管し今日中指定なしへ訂正して会社担当を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the original. I will correct my notes to show there was no instruction to call today and first find the company contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original, correct the lack of a same-day instruction, and find the company contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する内容が整理できましたね。それでは、また必要な際にご相談ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-TOYOTA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized what to check. Ask us again if needed. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この木材の文字の所で切るのか確認したいです。長さの数字と線が同じ端にあります。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 木材端の寸法文字と線が切断位置か加工前照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check whether to cut at the writing on this timber. The length numbers and a line are at the same end.
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before processing, ask whether the dimension writing and line at the timber end mark the cutting position. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機械へ渡す前に指導者と確認しましょう。すでに加工しましたか。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check with the instructor before passing it to the machine. Have you processed it already?

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。数字の下の線を切断位置だと思いましたが、作業票とは位置が合いません。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 加工未実施で手書き線と作業票位置不一致を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought the line under the numbers marked the cut, but its position does not match the work sheet.
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it is unprocessed and the handwritten line does not match the work sheet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その不一致を伝えてください。こちらの数字は注文寸法のメモで、切断の指示線ではありません。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell them about that discrepancy. These numbers are a note of the ordered dimensions, not a cutting instruction line.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で新しい線を描かず、実物と作業票を一緒に見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人で指示線を追加せず実物票を指導者へ示すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not draw a new line myself; I will have them look at the actual timber and work sheet together.
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will show the instructor the item and sheet without adding a line yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指導者が加工対象と必要な印を確認します。似た材へ入れ替えないでください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-07.translation: The instructor will check the item to process and the required marks. Do not swap it for similar timber.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の一本を保留にします。別の一本なら合うと考えて先に加工することもしません。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象一本を保留し別材へ自己交換して加工しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put this piece on hold. I will not process another piece first on the assumption that it matches.
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will hold this piece and not replace it yourself with another to process. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。指示を受けてから、担当範囲の作業を行ってください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Carry out the work within your role after receiving instructions.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文字を加工線と決めず、この一本の不一致を知らせ、指導者の確認が済むまで渡しません。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法文字を加工線と扱わず確認前は加工へ渡さないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide the writing is a processing line. I will report this piece's discrepancy and not pass it on until the instructor finishes checking.
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will not treat dimension writing as a processing line or pass it for processing before checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。気づいて止めてくださりありがとうございます。指導者をお呼びします。
DLG-SC-AKT-ODATE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for noticing and stopping. I will call the instructor.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 年間券を持っています。今日は友人と来ましたが、この券で二人とも入れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年間券一枚で友人同伴二人が入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an annual pass. I came with a friend today; can we both enter using this pass?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you and your friend can enter with one annual pass. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この年間券は記載されたご本人一人の物です。友人の方は別に受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This annual pass is for the named holder only. Your friend needs separate admission processing.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族や友人も同じ券で入れると思っていました。今日はどちらもまだ入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者利用可と思ったが二人とも未入園と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought family or friends could use the same pass too. Neither of us has entered yet today.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you thought companions could use it, but neither has entered yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ではご本人の年間券と、友人の受付を分けて確認しましょう。券はお客様のお名前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check your annual pass and your friend's admission separately. Is the pass in your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分の名前です。友人に渡して先に入ってもらうのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 年間券本人名義で友人への貸与予定ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my own name. I am not handing it to my friend to let them enter first.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the annual pass is in your name and you do not plan to lend it to your friend. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人はこちらで照合します。友人の入園方法は隣の受付で案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will verify yours here. The next desk will explain your friend's admission options.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人にも別受付と伝え、私の照合が済んでも入口の外で待ち合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人別受付と知らせ本人照合後も入口外で合流待ちすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my friend about the separate desk. Even after my verification, we will meet and wait outside the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend about separate admission and wait outside after your own check. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の前を塞がない位置でお待ちください。二人で入る時は各自の確認済みの券をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wait somewhere that does not block the desk. When entering together, each of you should carry your own verified ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 年間券は自分だけに使い、友人は別に受付してから二人で入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人年間券と友人別券各自確認後に二人で入ると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the annual pass only for myself, and after my friend completes separate admission, we will enter together.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will each have your own checked annual pass or ticket before entering together. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞ園内をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Enjoy your visit to the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近くで育った野菜を選びたいです。この住所が、畑のある場所なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 近隣産野菜の出品者住所が畑所在地か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to choose vegetables grown nearby. Is this address where the field is?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the seller's address on nearby-grown vegetables is the field location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄は出品者の連絡先です。野菜の産地は別の表示で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That field is the seller's contact address. Let us check the vegetables' origin on a separate label.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所が近いので、袋の全部がそこで育ったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近住所表示から全内容が同産地と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The address is nearby, so I thought everything in the bag was grown there.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you assumed all the contents came from the nearby address shown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出品者の住所だけでは産地を決められません。今日はどの野菜をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine origin from the seller's address alone. What vegetables are you looking for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 玉ねぎです。持っている二袋の産地欄をそれぞれ読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 玉ねぎ二袋の個別産地欄を読んで比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Onions. I would like to read the origin field on each of the two bags I am holding.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to read and compare the separate origin labels on two onion bags. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは産地の表示が見えます。もう一袋は札が折れていますので、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one's origin label is visible. The other bag's tag is folded, so I will check with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 折れた札の袋を近所産と決めず、表示が読める方を先に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札折れ未可読袋を近隣産と決めず読める袋を先確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume the folded-tag bag is locally grown. I will look first at the one whose label I can read.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume the unreadable folded-tag bag is local, and will check the readable one first. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。量や状態も合わせてお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Consider the quantity and condition too when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 産地欄が希望に合うと確認できた一袋を買います。出品者の住所とは別に読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望産地を確認した一袋を選び出品者住所とは別に読むと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy the one bag whose origin I have confirmed matches what I want. I will read that separately from the seller's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one bag with your desired origin confirmed, reading it separately from the seller's address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please go to checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 届いた楽譜のケースを受け取りたいです。友人が日本語を読めるので、受取の紙も全部書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人忘れ楽譜ケースの受取用紙を日本語得意な友人へ全面記入依頼できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to collect the sheet music case that has arrived. My friend can read Japanese; can they fill in the whole collection form for me too?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your Japanese-reading friend may complete the entire collection form for your forgotten sheet music case. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず持ち主と受取る方を確認します。ケースはお客様ご本人の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we will check the owner and collector. Is the case your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が電車へ置き忘れた物で、友人の物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電車へ置き忘れた本人所有で友人所有ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I left it on the train; it is not my friend's.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you own it and left it on the train, rather than it being your friend's. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用紙の説明を読む手伝いと、ご本人の受領確認は分けてください。署名はご本人へ案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish help reading the form's instructions from your own confirmation of receipt. We will guide you to sign yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人には説明を読んでもらい、私の名前で代わりに署名してもらうことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明読上げ補助と本人署名を分け代筆署名しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend will read the instructions to me, but I will not have them sign my name for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate reading assistance from your own signature, and say there will be no proxy signature. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容を確認できましたら、ご自身で受領欄をお書きください。物の特徴も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you understand the contents, fill in the receipt field yourself. We will also compare identifying features.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ケースの中に自分の書いた楽譜の表題があります。受け取る前にその特徴を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人記入の楽譜表題を特徴として受領前に示したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Inside the case is a sheet music title I wrote myself. I would like to describe that feature before collecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to give the title you wrote on the sheet music as an identifying feature before receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ご本人の物か確認します。受領の内容に不明な所は職員へ聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, we will check it is yours. Ask the staff if anything about receipt is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 特徴で照合し、友人の読み上げも聞いたうえで、自分で受領の意味を確認して署名します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特徴照合と内容理解後に本人が受領署名すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the features and hearing my friend's reading, I will confirm the meaning of receipt myself and sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will sign for receipt yourself after matching features and understanding the contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できましたらお渡しします。お越しくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hand it over once verified. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この机を買うと、同じ型の新しい物が家へ届くのでしょうか。展示の端に傷が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傷のある展示机購入で新品納品になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: If I buy this desk, will a new one of the same model be delivered to my home? I can see damage at the edge of the display desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether buying the damaged display desk means a new one will be delivered. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この値札は、ここにある現品一台の条件です。新品の取寄せの価格ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This price tag applies to this single actual item here. It is not the price for ordering a new one.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現品限りは見本だけ少ない意味と思っていました。届くのもこの机なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現品限定を見本不足と誤解しこの机が納品物と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought “display item only” meant there were few samples. So this very desk is what would be delivered?
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding of the limited actual item and confirm this desk is the delivery item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。状態を確認してからお決めください。持ち帰りか配送かも伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Decide after checking its condition. We will also ask whether you will take it home or need delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 配送を希望しますが、傷をまだ全部見ていないので注文は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配送希望だが現物状態未確認なので注文未確定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like delivery, but I will not confirm an order because I have not checked all the damage yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want delivery but have not confirmed the order because the condition is unchecked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配送の取扱いと費用は別に案内します。天板や脚を担当と確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain delivery availability and fees separately. You can check the top and legs with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 天板の端と脚の接続部を見たいです。値札の額だけで配送込みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 天板端と脚接続部の確認を頼み表示額を配送込みと扱わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to see the tabletop edge and leg joints. I will not assume the price tag includes delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the tabletop edge and leg joints and say the shown price is not assumed to include delivery. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態と合計額を確認できた後、ご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking the condition and total price, we will ask your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この現品の状態と配送条件を聞いてから買うか決めます。新品の取寄せとして注文しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現物状態と配送合計を確認後購入判断し新品注文としないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide whether to buy after hearing about this item's condition and delivery terms. I will not order it as a newly sourced item.
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will decide after checking the actual condition and delivery total, not place a new-item order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず状態をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AKT-ODATE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we will show its condition. Thank you for asking.
